$comment: The BRIEF track. No reference image exists and none is shown to anyone: contestants build the scene from these words alone, and the judge scores the render against the same words. That removes the memorisation shortcut the recall track depends on, so this track measures construction and invention instead of recall. `canvas` is the viewBox handed to contestants.

briefs.title: The Salon
briefs.subject: Kanye West
briefs.brief: A grand 18th-century salon gone to ruin. A vast gilt-framed portrait dominates the back wall above a grey marble fireplace; tall arched windows flank it, cool daylight entering from the right. The floor is buried in heavy white drapery, painted in thick impasto folds. A large black dog lies stretched across the foreground. Kanye West walks left to right in profile, mid-stride: oversized cream hoodie, dark cargo trousers, tall olive boots. Behind him, deeper in the room, a chestnut horse and a standing figure in a dark green coat. Palette: bone white, gilt ochre, deep umber, black-green. Everything outside the window light falls into shadow. Visible oil brushwork throughout, heaviest in the whites.
